Title: PLACEHOLDER: What student research groups produce, and what gets in the way
Abstract:
PLACEHOLDER ABSTRACT. This working paper describes the conditions under which small student research groups complete a project rather than abandoning it.

It sets out what a group needs in place before work starts — a defined question, a named lead, a meeting cadence, and access to sources it can actually reach — and identifies the points at which projects most often stall.

As a working paper, this has not been externally peer reviewed.
